title: 美国概览与十栏目目录
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Original high-fidelity concept board for 世界大百科, an existing Chinese field guide app for age 8, USA module. Approved art direction: calm modern geography atlas, background #F4F7FB, white #FFFFFF, ink #12243A, deep navy #12395B, accent orange #FF9A3D with dark ink, thin light-blue-gray strokes #DDE5EE, Noto Sans SC style bold simplified Chinese, 16px rounded white sections, generous margins, airy editorial rhythm and sharp real-photo-style scenic placeholders. Native app visual conventions. Do not redesign brand or insert decorative mascots, stars and stripes patterns, hardware frames, gradients in chrome, or background text. Only specified short Chinese labels; avoid tiny repetitive fake type. Subpages use local tools, only maps use the global four tabs. Separate flat screens with an airy gutter. No extraneous text apart from a restrained footer “美国模块 · 界面概念设计”. Photographic placeholders are illustrative, not source assets. Label any map or educational diagram “示意”. Clean editorial visual handoff, bold hierarchy, real-world text and controls.

Square board, two full-height flat 430:932 portrait phone screens of identical width. LEFT country overview. Photo-style wide Grand Canyon South Rim overlook at early daylight, layered ochre walls below open blue sky, warm rock without exaggerated sunset, foreground rim on right, left-side photo shadow only for readable white “美国”, “UNITED STATES”, “从大峡谷出发”. Back and bookmark. A rounded white area with “先认识美国” and factual row “北美洲 / 华盛顿特区 / 50 个州”. Three photo tiles “沿着山河走” (canyon layers), “走进城市” (New York modern city), “循着历史找” (Philadelphia Independence Hall). Two outlined tap rows “河流怎样刻出大峡谷？” and “华盛顿特区在哪里？”. Bottom wide orange “从大峡谷开始”. RIGHT “美国 · 探索目录”; heading “带着问题去探索”; small landscape mosaic canyon / city / red brick historic hall. Neat two-column grid in exact row order “国家名片 / 地理与气候 / 人们与语言 / 日常生活 / 饮食与物产 / 艺术与节日 / 城市与地标 / 动物与生态 / 历史故事 / 有趣问题”. Bottom landscape glimpse of deep-blue Great Lakes shoreline “下一站，去五大湖” and navy “打开美国地图”.
